verdict.rationale: Netlify gives every PR its own preview environment through Deploy Previews, so changes can be tested before they go live, and it claims Netlify Database supports 'safely iterating' on managed Postgres. Nothing documents that previews use isolated or branched data rather than production data, so the 'without touching production data' half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit preview-scoped database branching or data isolation, per-environment secrets/env var separation for previews, independent hands-on corroboration of sandboxed data testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Every PR gets a preview URL.
